Q9029.reason: Sterile water is hypotonic, so absorption through the bladder or breached mucosa can cause hemolysis and dilutional electrolyte imbalance such as hyponatremia.

Q9030.reason: The son is a donee beneficiary whose rights had not vested when the owner and landscaper modified the payee term, and he learned of the contract only after the payment.

Q9031.reason: Under UCC 2-210, a general ban on assigning the contract is read as barring only delegation, so the right to receive payment can still be assigned unless the clause clearly says otherwise.
